# SPD-100 — Remove the stray ledger/tickets/Untitled.md, which fails the acceptance suite

## Brief
The committed empty Obsidian note ledger/tickets/Untitled.md has frontmatter with no id, so 'spud import' refuses the corpus and test_acceptance.CutoverReadinessTest errors in setUpClass. It is the one error in an otherwise green 914-test suite, and it is outside every spudagent's reach: ledger/ is refused to everyone by the edit hook, and only Spud can remove it.

Evidence: Committed in 4de971b (BAD-090), identical on main. The failure reproduces on the main checkout with main's own code: 'python3.14 -I -S -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests -p test_acceptance.py -k CutoverReadiness' in /Users/ericlugo/Personal/Spud errors with 'ledger/tickets/Untitled.md: frontmatter lacks id'. The file's whole body is a frontmatter block of eight empty keys (status, priority, title, lead, proposed_by, origin, created, tags) and nothing else. My SPD-097 Phase 1 branch touches neither ledger/ nor bin/spudlib/imports/, and its committed tree is identical to main's.
